one_line: Early Chandela king who seized the sacred fortress of Kalinjar and made it his dynasty’s emblem.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, athletic and wiry with a disciplined soldier-king build
appearance.face: oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium-brown north Indian complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and light stubble, keen narrow dark eyes with slightly arched brows, default expression calm and watchful with a hint of strategist’s intensity
appearance.hair: thick black hair gathered into a high knotted topknot at the back of the crown, smooth and pulled tight from the forehead, with a narrow gold circlet resting low on the brow and a simple red tilak mark at the center
appearance.costume: era-accurate late 10th-century central Indian royal-warrior attire: a fitted sleeveless knee-length angarkha-style tunic in deep crimson cotton with a wrap front tied by hidden ties, worn over a long-sleeved fine off-white inner shirt; a wide dark indigo cotton patka (sash) with subtle woven geometric patterns wrapped twice around the waist and knotted at the left hip with its ends hanging to mid-thigh; straight, slightly tapered churidar-style trousers in muted beige, closely gathered at the ankles; sturdy brown leather sandals with toe straps; on the torso, a plain hammered bronze breastplate contoured but not exaggerated, strapped with leather over the angarkha; forearms protected by simple bronze bracers over the sleeves; minimal jewellery limited to a single thin gold armlet on the right upper arm and small round gold stud earrings, reflecting a practical yet royal field appearance.
appearance.signature: A straight, double-edged iron sword of early medieval north Indian type with a slightly broad leaf-shaped blade, plain iron crossguard, round steel pommel and a brown leather-wrapped grip, carried in a dark brown leather scabbard suspended from his indigo waist sash and often held resting against his shoulder to signify the conquest of Kalinjar.

ref_desc: Yashovarman is a medium-brown, sharp-cheeked warrior-king in his early 30s with a black topknot, gold brow circlet, crimson angarkha over off-white shirt, indigo waist sash, beige trousers, bronze breastplate and bracers, and a plain iron sword in a brown leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Yashovarman: an early-30s, athletic north Indian warrior-king with an oval, sharp-cheeked face, medium-brown complexion, keen dark eyes, straight nose, neat moustache and light stubble, wearing his thick black hair pulled tight into a high knotted topknot, adorned only with a narrow gold circlet across his brow and a small red tilak; dress him in a fitted sleeveless knee-length crimson angarkha-style tunic over a long-sleeved fine off-white inner shirt, a wide dark indigo patterned cotton sash wrapped twice around his waist and knotted at the left hip with ends hanging, straight slightly tapered beige churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles, and sturdy brown leather sandals; put a plain hammered bronze breastplate strapped over the tunic and simple bronze bracers on his forearms, with one thin gold armlet on his right upper arm and small round gold stud earrings for restrained royal detail; give him a straight double-edged iron sword with a simple crossguard, round pommel and brown leather-wrapped grip, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard hung from his sash, and show him in neutral, side and back views, emphasizing the deep crimson, dark indigo, off-white, beige and bronze colour palette and the grounded, thoughtful, strategist expression of an early Chandela conqueror of Kalinjar.
